---
title: "check-dependency-graph.yml"
---

Run the self-test of a notes repository's vendored
`build_dependency_graph.py`,
then build the graph of its definition and result divs and fail on a cycle.

The script comes from the `build-dependency-graph` action.
Notes repositories vendor it under `tools/`
so that a local render can run it as a `pre-render` step.
Nothing else runs the vendored copy's self-test,
so a change to the script in one repository
can break it without any check going red.

## What it does

1. Runs `<script-dir>/tests/test_build_dependency_graph.py`.
2. Runs `<script-dir>/build_dependency_graph.py` on the pages,
   writing the JSON to the runner's temporary directory.
   With `fail-on-cycle` it exits non-zero
   when a definition or result div
   depends on itself through other divs.

Forward references are printed and never fail the job.

## Inputs

| Input           | Type    | Default | Description |
| --------------- | ------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `script-dir`    | string  | `tools` | Directory holding the vendored script, with its self-test under `tests/`. |
| `pages-dir`     | string  | `chapters` | Directory under the repository root holding the pages (`.` when pages sit at the root). |
| `site`          | string  | the repository name | This site's name in cross-site node keys. |
| `fail-on-cycle` | boolean | `true`  | Fail the job when the graph has a cycle (else warn only). |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check dependency graph
on:
  push: { branches: [main] }
  pull_request:
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-dependency-graph.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   pages-dir: .
    #   runs-on: private-runner                # self-hosted runner label (private repositories only)
```

See `check-dependency-graph.yml` in
[`examples/`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/tree/main/examples)
for the full caller stub.
